content.title: 单次投入｜容器延迟变化与失控收束
content.summary: 一个小输入在封闭系统中延迟引发可追踪的扩张，人尝试纠正后留下终态。

quick_start.input_format: 容器＋一个投入物＋延迟反应＋纠正尝试＋终态
quick_start.recommended_input: 一名成年技师、一座桌面布料充气城市模型、一根可见总气管、一个压力表与一只上方回收气囊。
required_anchors: 纠正行为与残留结果都可见
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 一个小输入在封闭系统中延迟引发可追踪的扩张，人尝试纠正后留下终态。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: One clearly visible small input into a bounded system is followed by delayed local change, accelerating connected expansion and an attempted human correction that arrives too late to prevent an altered but traceable final state.

invariants.rule: One small deliberate input occurs in a visibly bounded, initially stable system before the anomaly.
invariants.purpose: Makes the later reaction causally legible.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible input the runaway result feels like an unrelated effect.

invariants.rule: A local material response expands continuously through the same system in distinguishable stages.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the system jumps directly to maximum scale, there is no readable delayed-response curve.

invariants.rule: The operator notices and makes a concrete checking or control action after onset but before the changed state settles.
invariants.purpose: Converts spectacle into a character-versus-system mini-story.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the operator never tries to intervene, the middle beat and human reaction arc disappear.

slots.name: system
slots.constraint: One visibly bounded original mechanism with traceable material or stored energy.

slots.name: small_input
slots.constraint: Single deliberate gesture that initiates the response.

slots.name: expanding_response
slots.constraint: Local onset followed by connected growth within one environment.

slots.name: operator_check
slots.constraint: Concrete, readable check after the response begins.

slots.name: terminal_state
slots.constraint: A materially changed end state, preferably controlled for the new instance.

slots.name: medium
slots.constraint: May change from fluid/foam to air-filled fabric or spring paper.

slots.name: sound
slots.constraint: New material-specific effects; do not attribute unheard source audio.

anti_copy_exclusions: No mage costume, spell book, potion flask, black cauldron, yellow-green pour, pale twin foam bubble, source dialogue/subtitle fragments or exact workbench framing.
Do not claim an exact original formula or source prompt from an unbound X reply.
No arbitrary repair action that resets the system or violates stored matter/energy.

instantiations.concept: In a modern theatre model shop, one adult technician nudges a pneumatic valve beside a miniature inflatable city. A single roof rises beyond its measuring mark, then linked buildings swell in sequence. She checks the pressure gauge and closes the inlet; pressure trapped downstream still lifts one connected fabric street. A clearly marked relief vent opens into an overhead collection canopy, leaving the model safely deflated and the technician stunned.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Theatre model-shop pneumatic miniature city: one valve error, staged linked inflation, gauge check, trapped downstream pressure, visible relief canopy.

instantiations.concept: In a printmaking studio, one apprentice pulls a single tension cord on a collapsible paper display. One panel opens, then connected spring-loaded leaves extend beyond their stop marks. She checks the release diagram and clamps the drive, but stored spring tension unfolds the remaining panels until a tether catches them in a final fan-shaped sculpture.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Printmaking studio spring-paper display: cord pull, staged panel unfolding, release check, stored spring tension, tethered sculptural endpoint.

failure_modes.failure: Material appears from nowhere or disconnected sections expand independently.
failure_modes.repair: Show the valve/tubing or cord/hinge continuity and one bounded expansion path.

failure_modes.failure: Operator check is only a facial expression.
failure_modes.repair: Show a specific gauge/diagram and a physical control attempt.
Release residual pressure through a visible vent or arrest motion with a tether while retaining changed geometry.
